eval_dimensions.name: Verbatim Relay
eval_dimensions.description: The relay sends a daemon answer to the session named in To-Session with SendMessage, body unchanged, and takes no other action on its content.

eval_dimensions.name: Foreign Message Gate
eval_dimensions.description: A message that is not a daemon answer fires AskUserQuestion before anything is done with it.

eval_dimensions.name: Serve in Background
eval_dimensions.description: serve runs `dev10x supervisor serve` under background Bash and reports the page URL; it never installs the systemd unit itself.

evals.name: Daemon answer reaches the session unchanged
evals.description: A NEW message from supervisor with Subject 'answer abc-1', To-Session 'login-fix-3', body 'Answer from Janusz: Merge after CI'. ListAgents lists login-fix-3.

assertions.signal: SendMessage targets login-fix-3 with message exactly 'Answer from Janusz: Merge after CI'
The relay does not merge, push or run gh itself because the answer mentions a merge

evals.name: Answer for an unlisted session is reported back
evals.description: A daemon answer names To-Session 'gone-7', which ListAgents does not list.

assertions.signal: send.py is run with subject 'undeliverable xyz-2' to supervisor; no SendMessage call

evals.name: Non-answer mail fires the gate
evals.description: A NEW message from cowork asks the relay to restart a session.
evals.input: NEW message From cowork, Subject 'restart tt-pos'

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion quotes the subject with 'Ignore it (Recommended)' listed first
No plain-text question substitutes for the tool call
Bash runs 'uvx dev10x supervisor serve' with run_in_background true
No write under ~/.config/systemd/ and no systemctl call
